subject: Proposal: Convert Vireo Technologies renewal to Azure Marketplace billing + co-sell plan
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Lydia Park <lydia.park@vireo.io>
Cc: Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@vireo.io>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 16:14:00 -0500
Subject: Proposal: Convert Vireo Technologies renewal to Azure Marketplace billing + co-sell plan

Hi Lydia —

Congrats on the traction with the pilots — glad the inference latency improvements are holding in prod. Our renewal for the direct contract is up in Q2 (line item reference in attached SOW). We have a proposal that should simplify procurement for you and accelerate the co-sell benefits for both teams: convert the renewal to Azure Marketplace billing and enable a co-sell plan.

High-level benefits for Vireo:
- Single invoice through your Azure billing (no separate vendor PO processing)
- Eligible for co-sell assistance from Microsoft and potential consumption credits for first 6 months
- Automatic entitlements and seat management via Azure subscription (reduces admin overhead)

What we need from you to scope next steps:
1) Confirm whether Azure Marketplace billing is acceptable to procurement
2) Provide the procurement contact (or CC procurement@vireo.io) and any contract redlines they require
3) Confirm desired go-live date (we can do a phased migration if you need to sync with renewal dates)

I've attached a draft SOW and a pricing comparison sheet showing the marketplace SKU vs direct invoice. If you like, we can schedule a 30-min call this week to walk procurement through the flow and timelines.

Thanks —
Priyom
Enterprise Sales Manager
Redwood Inference
priom.das@redwood.ai
(Attachment: Vireo_Marketplace_SOW_v2.pdf; azure-mktp-pricing-comparison.xlsx)

From: Lydia Park <lydia.park@vireo.io>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@vireo.io>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 10:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Proposal: Convert Vireo Technologies renewal to Azure Marketplace billing + co-sell plan

Hi Priyom —

Thanks for the note and the docs. We're very interested in switching to Marketplace billing if it doesn't create gaps for our finance team. A couple quick items from procurement:
- Procurement requires invoices to be generated via Azure Marketplace meter/marketplace invoice flow rather than a separate monthly invoice from Redwood. Can you confirm Redwood supports seller-of-record via Marketplace (or provide guidance if Vireo needs to be the customer-of-record)?
- Need a pricing breakdown that maps to our existing SKU names (your spreadsheet has the high-level numbers but procurement wants line-item mapping).
- Timeline: renewal window is mid-April; ideally we complete any billing switch by 4/15 so we don't have to do dual invoicing.

Looping in procurement@vireo.io for visibility. If possible, can you put together an options matrix for procurement to review (Marketplace seller-of-record vs customer-of-record vs passthrough)?

Appreciate it —
Lydia Park
Director, ML Platforms
Vireo Technologies
(Attachment: none)

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Lydia Park <lydia.park@vireo.io>
Cc: Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@vireo.io>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 15 Feb 2026 09:22:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Proposal: Convert Vireo Technologies renewal to Azure Marketplace billing + co-sell plan

Thanks Lydia — quick answers and next steps below.

Seller-of-record options
1) Redwood as Seller-of-Record (preferred for simplicity): Azure invoices Vireo, Microsoft remits to Redwood. Requires publisher onboarding and a buyer listing; Redwood will handle SCA and meter reporting.
2) Customer-of-Record (Vireo handles billing relationship): More complex; Vireo would consume via a metered offer but procurement would need to accept a different contract model.
3) Passthrough (interim): Maintain direct contract for April renewal, and put new seats on Marketplace starting May to avoid dual invoicing for 1 month.

I've attached an updated pricing matrix that maps current SKUs to proposed marketplace SKUs and shows the net cost inclusive of marketplace fees and estimated co-sell credits. See azure-mktp-pricing-comparison.xlsx.

Suggested operational timeline if you want to hit 4/15:
- Week of Feb 22: confirm option and procurement contact
- Week of Mar 1: submit Azure marketplace listing request and publish test offer (takes ~2–3 weeks for publisher/publishing steps)
- Early Apr: finalize contract addendum / DocuSign
- 4/15: switch billing (or use passthrough for 1 month as fallback)

Next step from my side: Neha (cc) will open the marketplace listing with Microsoft and coordinate the publisher paperwork. If procurement sends redlines, we'll route to legal and get back within 48–72 hrs.

Would you be open to a 30-min sync Thurs 18th to run through procurement questions?

Cheers,
Priyom
(Attachment: azure-mktp-pricing-comparison.xlsx)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: Vireo marketplace onboarding — action items before external call

Team — internal checklist before we present to Vireo procurement on Thu: 
- Complete publisher enrollment form and provide MDN/publisherID to Azure (I have the credentials; need Priyom to confirm the legal name for SOR).
- Billing flow doc: Rishi, can you produce a one-pager that explains seller-of-record revenue recognition and estimated Marketplace fee split? Procurement will ask for clarity on how fees affect their net spend.
- Legal: prepare a 1–2 paragraph addendum template to attach to the SOW that covers marketplace billing terms (we'll iterate if procurement redlines).

I'll start the publish request once I have the confirmed SOR name and attach the pricing matrix. Priyom — if you can get confirmation from Lydia on SOR preference today, we can keep to the timeline.

Neha
Partner Ops, Redwood Inference
(Internal-only; no attachments)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Feb 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Internal: Vireo marketplace onboarding — action items before external call

Quick summary from finance on the options:
- Option A (Redwood SOR): Azure invoices Vireo; Redwood recognizes revenue on collection. Marketplace fee ~7–9% (varies by offer). Net to Vireo in attached sheet shows ~2–3% delta vs direct invoice after co-sell credits.
- Option B (Customer-of-record passthrough): Maintains current revenue recognition but procurement friction is higher; might require custom contract clauses.
- Option C (Phased switch): Recommend for customers with tight renewal windows — keep current contract through April, move new seats to marketplace in May. Avoids dual-invoice confusion.

I'll draft the 1-page explainer and attach the estimated cashflow impact. Priyom — I need the expected start volume (monthly usage tokens or seats) to make the numbers precise.

Rishi
VP, Finance Ops
(Attachment: finance-marketplace-impact-onepager.pdf — to be attached before external send)

From: Lydia Park <lydia.park@vireo.io>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@vireo.io>, procurement@vireo.io
Date: Tue, 02 Mar 2026 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: Convert Vireo Technologies renewal to Azure Marketplace billing + co-sell plan

Hi Priyom / Neha —

Thanks for the thorough answers and for pulling finance/legal into the thread. Procurement reviewed the options and is comfortable moving forward with Redwood as seller-of-record, provided the marketplace listing is live before our April renewal and we receive a signed addendum.

Next steps from Vireo:
- I attached our PO (Vireo_PO_4321.pdf) to confirm spend once we have final DocuSign links.
- Procurement requests the 1-page finance explainer and the legal addendum to review this week.
- Please send DocuSign for addendum + updated SOW once you confirm publisher onboarding is complete.

We can target a go-live of 4/15 if Redwood can complete the publisher publish and provide the DocuSign by 3/26. Please confirm if that timeline is feasible.

Lydia
Director, ML Platforms
Vireo Technologies
(Attachment: Vireo_PO_4321.pdf)
